hero.label: Compliance
hero.title: Regulatory-Grade Compliance Infrastructure
hero.desc: CCASH provides a complete compliance operations framework built for money-services operations. KYC/KYB, document management, audit trails, and regulatory reporting out of the box.

features.title: KYC/KYB Onboarding
features.text: Multi-level identity verification for both individuals and entities. Automated document collection, verification workflows, and risk scoring integrated into the platform.

features.title: Document Management
features.text: Secure document vault with version control, expiration tracking, and automated renewal workflows. All documents encrypted at rest and in transit.

features.title: Multi-Jurisdiction Support
features.text: Compliance framework covering EU, UK, US, and emerging market regulations. Configurable rules engines adapt to local requirements without code changes.

features.title: Audit Trail & Reporting
features.text: Complete immutable audit trail for all operations. Automated regulatory reporting templates with export to standard formats. Ready for regulator inquiries.

info_blocks.title: Compliance Operations Suite
items: KYC/KYB Verification: Multi-level identity verification with document collection and automated validation
Jurisdictional Controls: Configurable eligibility rules per jurisdiction with automated enforcement
Document Management: Secure vault with versioning, expiration tracking, and renewal automation
Audit Trail: Complete transaction history with tamper-evident logging for regulatory inquiries
Reporting: Automated report generation with templates for common regulatory frameworks
